en:
Angie is right. We should let go of our
desire to escape.
Then we can live here in peace...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

Sure. I have no student council work to
attend to at the moment.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I killed some
time awkwardly...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
